references.text: The thornbush threatens with fire that will consume the cedars of Lebanon, a parallel to Jotham's warning about mutual destruction between Abimelech and the citizens of Shechem.
Fulfillment of the prophecy: About a thousand men and women died when the tower in Shechem was burned with fire.
God repaid Abimelech's wickedness and the wickedness of Shechem, just as Jotham's curse predicted.
Fire that goes out from Heshbon and consumes the cities of Moab, a similar poetic description of destructive fire.
Fire that goes out from the mouth and consumes enemies, a similar image of divine judgment through fire.
The Lord will repay each person according to their deeds, a principle fulfilled in Jotham's prophecy.
